message: docs: reconcile finite activity delivery, obsolete recovery tasks and performance prerequisites

replacements.new: AE already supplies acquired finite methods and committed multi-output bindings. Broader control/family coverage, fire recovery and sustained survival remain (AC06/AC09); do not rebuild the delivered learning/execution owner.

replacements.old: - [x] AC03.5 Persist bounded unresolved attempts and reason-specific dependency signatures using existing ownership. Suppress unchanged failures without suppressing different targets, methods or quantities. No automatic paid repair loop.
replacements.new:
- [x] AC03.5 Persist bounded unresolved attempts and reason-specific dependency signatures using existing ownership. Suppress unchanged failures without suppressing different targets, methods or quantities. No automatic paid repair loop.
- [ ] **AC03.6 — Reconcile typed fire-care requests with the installed finite watch.** At `b528af6`, `worlds/base/typed-requests.ts` still declares repeated fuelling unavailable. `typed-actions.ts` applies that authored revision before the installed activity-request path in `action-grounding.ts`, so “tend the fire until dawn” can offer only staying nearby and a request without a time can be refused for a capability that now exists. Route supported requests through PW10’s existing trusted compiler/admission; obtain the required fire, supply, finite deadline/fuel budget and mode rather than inventing them or adding a second watch executor. Keep truly unsupported indefinite care explicit. Qualify ordinary text, exact structured selection, missing parameters, no-AI behavior, refusal and confirmation without hidden fuel consumption or a paid retry. Update the [world wording](../worlds/base/typed-requests.md) from the same owner. This is a confirmed integration gap, not a claim that PW10 is absent or authorization for unlimited tending.

replacements.old: The owner's [discussion-only proposal](../projects/embodied-survival-tech-design.md#learned-activities-discussion-only) would reuse successful methods without reselecting every normal step. AC06.3–AC06.5 remain open (AC06.1–AC06.2 are delivered for requested activities; see [below](#composed-activities-slice)): hunting needs a bounded repeat/stop condition, harvesting needs actual multiple-output bindings, and cooking needs current resource/location checks. Extend the saved AG03 frontier rather than add a parallel plan store. A cognition opportunity can offer the remaining activity alongside alternatives; a miss need not terminate it, whereas lost access, threat, unavailable heat or invalid outputs can require reconsideration. Completed receipts stay in memory/state even when omitted from the remaining-step display. No learned loop was implemented or silently substituted for the individual choices tested here.
replacements.new: The earlier [discussion-only survival proposal](../projects/embodied-survival-tech-design.md#learned-activities-discussion-only) did not authorize automatic learned routines. Subsequent [AE delivery](action-experience.md) implements personally acquired finite methods, actual output bindings, scoped offers and selected execution through the existing AG03 frontier. Requested holding/time predicates and bounded repetitions are also delivered; broader AC06.3–AC06.5 semantics and family coverage remain open. Reuse those owners rather than build a second plan or learning store. General conditional hunting/cooking routines, inferred branches and automatic survival policy are not established by the finite examples. A cognition opportunity may offer the remaining activity alongside alternatives; committed receipts persist even when omitted from that display. Current heat, access, outputs and resources still require native revalidation. The historical individual-choice trials remain what they measured, not evidence for the later learned-method path.

replacements.old: - **Tending a fire:** single requests such as "feed", "fuel" or "stoke the fire", "light the fire" or "put the fire out" ground to [fire care](survival.md#tending-the-campfire). Ongoing tending ("tend", "keep" or "mind" the fire, optionally "burning", "going", "lit" or "alive") until a named time becomes a disclosed revision, staying by the heat source until that time, because repeated fuelling is not an ongoing activity yet (AC06). The player sees the omission "keep the fire fuelled: Fuelling a fire again and again is not an ongoing activity yet; add fuel yourself." and must accept it. Without a time it is refused with "Keeping a fire going is not an ongoing activity yet; add fuel to it or light it instead."
replacements.new: - **Tending a fire:** single requests such as "feed", "fuel" or "stoke the fire", "light the fire" or "put the fire out" ground to [fire care](survival.md#tending-the-campfire). The separately chosen [finite watch](camp-routines.md) now supports repeated care within explicit supply, time and fuel bounds; it is not indefinite tending. **Current integration defect:** the older typed vocabulary for "tend", "keep" or "mind" the fire still calls repeated fuelling unavailable. Until a named time it offers staying nearby as a disclosed revision; without a time it refuses. That is stale wording/routing, not the current capability boundary. [AC03.6](../../maintainers/action-capabilities.md#ac03--bounded-action-grounding) owns reconciliation with the installed activity compiler and required parameters. Do not infer a watch’s supply/budget, silently substitute passive waiting or add another executor.
